device_overview.product_code_desc: Device model code (Critical!): Can be used to determine the specific device model.
device_overview.serial_number_fb_desc: Device unique serial number: Unique identifier for each device, used to distinguish different devices, similar to 'Device ID'.
device_overview.boot_method_desc: Device boot method: Uses UEFI boot (mainstream method for modern Android devices, replacing traditional BIOS), affects bootloader compatibility.
device_overview.max_download_size_desc: Fastboot max download size: Image files flashed via fastboot cannot exceed this size (prevents transfer errors).
device_overview.parallel_flash_desc: Support parallel flashing: Can flash multiple partition images simultaneously (e.g., boot and dtbo at the same time), improving flashing speed.
device_overview.off_mode_charge_desc: Off-mode charging: Indicates whether 'charging screen when powered off' is enabled (customizable on some devices), 1 means enabled.
device_overview.fb_unlock_status_desc: Bootloader unlocked (Critical!): Indicates the device is unlocked and supports flashing third-party ROMs, recovery, etc.; Locked status cannot modify system底层.
device_overview.fb_secure_boot_desc: Secure boot enabled: Indicates the device has Secure Boot enabled, only allows verified system images (e.g., official ROM) to boot; If you need to flash third-party images, you may need to disable it (supported on some devices).
device_overview.fb_anti_rollback_desc: Anti-rollback protection: Indicates anti-rollback is enabled, prohibits flashing bootloader / baseband with lower version numbers, avoiding downgrade vulnerabilities.
device_overview.fb_current_mode_desc: Current mode: Indicates being in pure bootloader low-level mode (Android user space not loaded), user space mode is rare.
device_overview.fb_slot_count_desc: Partition slot count: Indicates support for A/B dual slots (A slot: _a partition, B slot: _b partition).
device_overview.fb_active_slot_desc: Current active slot: Device currently boots using A slot (_a partition), if A slot fails, it will automatically switch to B slot.
device_overview.fb_hw_version_desc: Hardware version number: Distinguishes device hardware batches (e.g., different factories, different component versions), different hardware versions may affect ROM compatibility.
device_overview.fb_battery_voltage_desc: Current battery voltage: Unit is mV (millivolts), belongs to normal battery voltage range (full charge about 4.4-4.5V), indicates battery is currently supplying power normally.
device_overview.fb_battery_status_desc: Battery status: Indicates battery is sufficient (usually > 20%), meets flashing / operation requirements; if battery is too low, cannot perform low-level operations.
device_overview.fb_cpuid_desc: CPU unique ID: Unique identifier for identifying device CPU chip, used to distinguish different CPU batches (generally used for debugging).

partition_desc.xbl: Qualcomm low-level bootloader; initializes hardware and loads subsequent programs (Qualcomm devices only)
partition_desc.xbl_config: Stores xbl hardware adaptation parameters to fit the device
partition_desc.abl: Android Boot Loader; loads the boot kernel and decides which A/B slot to boot
partition_desc.boot: Stores the Android kernel + ramdisk; flash a Magisk-patched image to gain Root
partition_desc.dtbo: Supplements hardware config with dynamically modifiable parameters (third-party ROM/Recovery needs adaptation)
partition_desc.vendor_boot: Stores vendor-customized boot resources that supplement boot (common on Android 11+)
partition_desc.imagefv: UEFI image verification for boot security (anti-tamper)
partition_desc.uefisecapp: Runs UEFI security programs (e.g. Secure Boot verification)
partition_desc.vbmeta: Stores partition signatures for AVB verification; add --disable-verity when flashing third-party images
partition_desc.vbmeta_system: Verifies the integrity of the system partition specifically
partition_desc.modem: Stores baseband firmware controlling 5G/4G / Bluetooth / WiFi; must match regional firmware
partition_desc.modemst: Stores dynamic baseband config; recoverable by reboot after wiping
partition_desc.fsg: Stores baseband security policy; must match the modem version
partition_desc.fsc: Stores the fsg encryption certificate to verify fsg integrity
partition_desc.bluetooth: Stores Bluetooth firmware controlling Bluetooth connections (separate partition on this device)
partition_desc.super: Contains sub-partitions like system/vendor/product; flash this partition first when flashing the system
partition_desc.userdata: Stores personal data; fastboot erase userdata performs a factory reset
partition_desc.cust: Stores vendor region / carrier customizations (e.g. China MIUI features)
partition_desc.logo: Stores the boot Logo / animation; can be replaced by flashing custom files
partition_desc.splash: Stores the boot splash screen, which may include simple animation (unlike the static logo)
partition_desc.keymaster: Runs the Keymaster module and stores system keys (hardware-level encryption)
partition_desc.vm-keystore: Provides key storage / signature verification for the Android VM
partition_desc.secdata: Stores lightweight security config (e.g. Secure Boot state, anti-rollback number)
partition_desc.storsec: Controls storage access permissions to prevent physical data extraction
partition_desc.frp: Stores Google FRP lock data; fastboot erase frp before flashing skips activation
partition_desc.devinfo: Stores device hardware parameters to confirm device identity at boot
partition_desc.persist: Stores hardware calibration data (e.g. sensor / camera parameters); wiping causes hard-to-recover hardware issues
partition_desc.persistbak: Backs up persist data to restore a damaged persist partition
partition_desc.logdump: Stores system logs to locate faults when the device malfunctions
partition_desc.minidump: Stores a compact memory snapshot of system crashes for analysis
partition_desc.rawdump: Stores a full crash memory snapshot for complex troubleshooting
partition_desc.oops: Stores kernel error logs to quickly locate kernel faults
partition_desc.dbg: Stores debug mode config (e.g. USB debugging permissions)
partition_desc.rescue: Stores an emergency rescue system for repair / backup when the main system fails
partition_desc.ffu: Stores vendor fast-repair firmware, flashed via QPST to fix low-level faults
partition_desc.msadp: Stores emergency repair programs for the baseband / application processor
partition_desc.aop: Stores audio codec firmware controlling audio hardware (Qualcomm only)
partition_desc.tz: Runs the TEE system, providing hardware-level security isolation (e.g. fingerprint / payment encryption)
partition_desc.hyp: Manages CPU virtualization resources for Android virtualization features
partition_desc.cmnlib: Provides secure interfaces for TEE; the 64-bit version (cmnlib64) fits 64-bit TEE
partition_desc.devcfg: Stores Qualcomm chipset hardware config to ensure external hardware is recognized
partition_desc.qupfw: Controls power management (e.g. charging current / sleep power) to keep power stable
partition_desc.dsp: Stores DSP firmware processing audio/video signals (improves multimedia efficiency)
partition_desc.ddr: Stores memory initialization parameters to prevent memory detection failure
partition_desc.mdmddr: Stores baseband memory initialization parameters to prevent memory detection failure
partition_desc.cdt: Stores Qualcomm chipset hardware info to confirm chip specs at boot
partition_desc.bk: Stores feature configs such as camera algorithms, screen parameters, and charging policies
partition_desc.bk41: Backs up A/B slot config to prevent slot switch failure
partition_desc.bk42: Stores sensor backups, Bluetooth / WiFi config, RF parameters, etc.
partition_desc.countrycode: Stores the sales region code; the system loads corresponding regional features
partition_desc.featenabler: Controls Xiaomi-exclusive feature switches (e.g. MIUI privacy protection, fast charging)
partition_desc.limits: Limits system resource usage to prevent hardware overload
partition_desc.misc: Stores temporary config (e.g. reboot mode, OTA status)
partition_desc.multiimgqti: Stores Qualcomm QTI multi-image loading parameters for component coordination
partition_desc.multiimgoem: Stores Xiaomi-customized multi-image parameters to fit third-party hardware
partition_desc.oem_misc1: Stores Xiaomi OEM temporary data (e.g. test logs, warranty info)
partition_desc.ssd: Records UFS flash health status to optimize storage performance
partition_desc.spunvm: Stores the Xiaomi secure VM image to provide privacy isolation
partition_desc.switch: Stores the device mode flag that decides the boot mode at startup
partition_desc.uefivarstore: Stores UEFI dynamic variables to keep boot parameters consistent
partition_desc.vm-data: Stores Android VM runtime data to improve boot efficiency
partition_desc.mdm1m9kefs: Stores baseband EFS data (e.g. IMEI); damage causes no signal and is hard to recover
